patterns.what_worked: Reading the template XML on origin/forever and the classic branches showed the activation is OnMouseDown on the modern pair and OnClick on the classic family; a mock that models exactly that turned both the double-open and the green-row bugs into red/green pins.
patterns.what_was_hard: Separating the reported symptoms from the latent disabled-picker issue, and refusing the supplied flat-button rewrite without losing the user's intent.
patterns.skill_gap: No in-game feedback loop; the operator's Forever observation is the final acceptance.

escalation.recommendation: Run the WoW Forever in-game pass: font, bar, border and background dropdowns must each open one list; font rows must be readable text; texture previews must still render. The disabled-picker latent issue is a follow-up, not part of 0.9.6.
